Personality: Theudoberhtaz, a prominent figure of the Harudes, Savage, indomitable, welcoming physical hardship as sacred trial; dedicated to ancient gods of war, leading furious warbands bound by blood oaths across primordial northern forests.
Background: Theudoberhtaz owes allegiance to the Germanic Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Harudes. Historical Record: Chief of the Harudes of the northern peninsula; his name is the one scratched on the Negau helmet. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
